name: Locked off
prompt: Locked-off tripod camera, no camera movement; only the subject moves.

name: Slow push-in
prompt: Slow, smooth dolly push-in toward the main character, gently increasing intimacy.

name: Pull-back reveal
prompt: Slow dolly pull-back that gradually reveals more of the environment around the character.

name: Pan left
prompt: Smooth horizontal pan from right to left following the action.

name: Tilt-up reveal
prompt: Camera starts low and tilts up smoothly to reveal the character and the scene.

name: Handheld
prompt: Subtle handheld camera with natural micro-shake, documentary feel, stays framed on the subject.

name: 360 orbit
prompt: Camera orbits smoothly around the character in a half circle while the character stays centered and in focus.

name: Crane up
prompt: Camera rises vertically like a crane shot, ending in a high wide view of the scene.

name: Drone flyover
prompt: Aerial drone shot gliding forward and slightly downward over the location toward the character.

name: Dolly zoom (vertigo)
prompt: Vertigo dolly-zoom: the background stretches away while the character stays the same size, dramatic tension.

name: Tracking side shot
prompt: Camera tracks alongside the walking/running character at the same speed, parallax background.

name: Over the shoulder
prompt: Over-the-shoulder framing from behind one character looking at the other, slight slow push.

name: Crash zoom
prompt: Sudden fast crash zoom onto the character's face for a comedic or dramatic reaction beat.

name: Whip pan
prompt: Very fast whip pan with motion blur that snaps to the new subject.

name: Speed ramp
prompt: Action plays fast, then slows into dramatic slow motion at the key moment, then speeds back up.

name: Bullet time
prompt: Frozen-moment bullet time: the action almost stops while the camera arcs quickly around the character.

name: Reaction close-up
prompt: Quick punch-in to an extreme close-up of the character's surprised expression, then hold.

name: Playful bounce
prompt: Gentle playful camera bob and slight zoom pulses in rhythm with the character's movement, cheerful cartoon energy.

name: Storybook drift
prompt: Soft slow sideways drift with a slight zoom, like turning a page in an illustrated storybook, calm and warm.

name: Magic reveal
prompt: Camera slowly pushes in while sparkles and light swirl around the character, wonder and delight.
